scope: Unchanged CLK002 external EM-only massless unscreened static weak-field first-response benchmark in imported 3+1 metric spacetime and proper time. Rb87/Cs133 hyperfine and actual TiAlV/PtRh alloys retained. x=d^2>=0 is not fitted. Positive attractive calibration factors and a declared validity domain are required. No lattice, volume or continuum limit; no Markov-time reinterpretation.

DD2010.finding: Pair potential supplies G_AB=G_star*(1+alpha_A*alpha_B); full electromagnetic mass sensitivities, not primed contrasts alone. It does not identify an operational solar estimator.

HEES2018.finding: Frozen source action and response baseline; no new finite-potential remainder certificate supplied.

GUENA2012.locator: PDF2 uncertainty/weights; PDF3 Fig3 and Eq4
GUENA2012.finding: Positive U=GM_sun/r, maximum at perihelion; annual cosine uses Jan3 2010, MJD55199 and approximate semiamplitude1.65e-10 in U/c^2. Monthly-scale bins and fixed/free phase, with/without slope fits are discussed. Printed constants do not name an ephemeris version, time scale, or a bare-to-operational calibration/error law.

SYRTE2015.finding: Reports updated solar coefficient (7.4+/-6.5)e-7. Plot bars are total1sigma, systematics dominated; this is not an independently supplied annual-projection covariance/coverage contract. Earlier sign convention is cross-reference context, not proof that the later estimator design is identical. Overlapping2012 data are not independent replicates.

GUENA2014.locator: PDF7 sectionIVD; PDF8 Fig7; PDF9 sectionVI/Fig8
GUENA2014.finding: Clock correction procedures and temporally correlated TypeB systematics are explicit. The warning against overinterpreting a small constant-fit standard error concerns that absolute-frequency fit, not a demonstration of harmful annual leakage. A constant nuisance can cancel; the actual annual error projection is required.

HEES2016.finding: Independent Gaussian measurement/flat-prior Bayesian power analysis at scanned frequencies is not the signed phase-fixed solar coefficient or its nuisance-uniform coverage. No oscillating-dark-matter model or posterior limit is imported.

BERNUS2023.locator: PDF11 sectionIII; PDF22 EqA29; PDF23 EqA33-A39
BERNUS2023.finding: Pair coupling and rescaled measurable masses are distinct. The source re-adjusts reference ephemeris parameters for each dilaton choice. EqA38 drops post-Newtonian and quadratic small-delta terms. Its fitted intervals do not supply exact-in-x calibration of the clock owner's normalization.

KLIONER2007.finding: Matching linear scalings of coordinate time, distance and mass parameter preserve mu/r. An isolated time-scale multiplier on gamma is not justified. Actual time tags/phase remain owner inputs.

IAU2015B3.finding: Exact nominal conversion constants are not true solar properties with uncertainty. Exact nominal GM cannot replace model-bare GM or measured calibration.

PARK2021.finding: DE440 uses TDB integration, explicit UTC/TAI/TT/TDB handling, GR-constrained PPN dynamics and fitted solar/Earth mass parameters. It is not asserted to be the ephemeris of the2015 clock result.

MICRO2022.locator: PDF4 Eq1-2; PDF11 Eq6; PDF17-19; PDF25 section5.7; PDF27-28 Eq14/17/19
MICRO2022.finding: delta_x=ac11*delta and eta=delta/mbar, so eta=delta_x/(ac11*mbar). Scale specification |ac11-1|<0.02 is not a probability law. Segment systematics use estimated-effect RSS; final budget is an inverse-statistical-variance weighted linear mean, not RSS across segments. Reported1sigma and Gaussian residual consistency are not a total model-uniform coverage certificate.

MICROANALYSIS2020.locator: PDF11-12 section3.5; PDF23-24 Table1; PDF26 AppendixB1; PDF30 EqB9
MICROANALYSIS2020.finding: Normal noises and unbiased calibration estimators are assumptions. ac11 cannot be estimated in the stated scheme; a random-law construction is suggested but not pursued. EqB9 is a conditional variance estimate with neglected terms and estimated parameters. Instrumental quadratic effects are not CLK002 nonlinear-field remainder bounds; ad11 is not ac11.

MECM2016.finding: Coefficient covariance uses an estimated covariance plug-in approximation. Simulations test specified configurations; they are not uniform coverage over the fixed model's unknown calibration/material/remainder domain.

GUM2008.finding: Correlation and distribution assumptions matter. A standard uncertainty is not automatically an interval with a specified coverage probability; expanded uncertainty needs the factor, interpretation and limitations. Historical metrology guidance only, no claim of current compliance.

VIM_COVERAGE.finding: State the probability interpretation. A coherent epistemic law and uniform repeated-sampling coverage are distinct; neither may silently be substituted for the other.

findings.source_sign: GUENA2012 explicitly uses positive U=GM/r; no sign contradiction with the frozen negative scalar-response coefficient was found.
findings.new_progress: The missing input is estimator-projected calibration and total error, not a generic GM ratio or mandatory full raw-data archive. Sufficient influence/Gram statistics and certified projected error can be enough.

calibration_bound.conditional_statement: If v=gamma*u+Z*c+r_v, H=u^T*W*P*u>0, then |gamma_eff-gamma|<=sqrt(r_v^T*W*P*r_v/H). This is weighted Cauchy-Schwarz on range(P), not an empirical bound.
calibration_bound.weaker_exact_condition: ell^T*(v-gamma*u)=0 also suffices for gamma_eff=gamma; pointwise proportionality is not necessary.

freefall_coverage_contract.fitted_to_target: eta=delta_x/(ac11*mbar); ac11*mbar must be kept as a positive calibrated nuisance factor, not silently set to one.
freefall_coverage_contract.conditional_set: If delta_hat_x=a*eta+bias+epsilon, a in [a_min,a_max] with a_min>0, |bias|<=B, and P(|epsilon|<=r_alpha)>=1-alpha, use {eta: exists a in [a_min,a_max], |delta_hat_x-a*eta|<=B+r_alpha}. Calibration intervals with their own failure probabilities join the common union-bound budget.
freefall_coverage_contract.warning: Do not assign B to the printed1.5e-15 systematic standard uncertainty or V to the square of2.3e-15 without the required justification. Ordinary conditional metrological inference is not refuted.

remaining_input_contract.priority: One owner-auditable2015 signed annual estimator projection/calibration/error packet: actual u,Z,W or equivalent sufficient Gram/influence statistics; mask/binning/epoch/time/phase/normalization; fixed-model v(x) mapping or residualized template bound over a declared x domain; projected total error law or bias/moment bounds with explicit coverage interpretation.
remaining_input_contract.other_still_open: A solar packet alone does not discharge freefall scale and total projected error, full atomic/material sensitivities, higher-order/finite-response remainders or a common joint probability interpretation. These remain explicit inputs, not additional automatic research tasks.
remaining_input_contract.sufficient_not_unique: Raw measurements are one route, not a logical requirement if the owner supplies independently auditable sufficient statistics and certified error propagation.

next_question: Does a newly supplied source-owned annual projection packet certify gamma_eff(x) and its total projected error over the frozen model's declared validity domain?
reentry: New auditable packet or an exact source-audit correction, followed by a bounded review. No unchanged search replay, automatic successor proof, empirical fit or silent comparison adoption.
non_claims: No observational detection/exclusion, real annual systematic counterexample, invalidation of the cited experiments, independent holdout, TECT microscopic admission, Pre-A, A/B, spacetime, QFT, GR, horizon, continuum, mass gap or TOE conclusion. Synthetic exact fixtures diagnose non-implications only.
